message_blocks_payload_check.name: message_blocks_payload_check
message_blocks_payload_check.value: ("message_blocks"."type" = 'text' and "message_blocks"."text" is not null and "message_blocks"."image_id" is null) or ("message_blocks"."type" = 'image' and "message_blocks"."text" is null and "message_blocks"."image_id" is not null)

messages_payload_by_type_check.name: messages_payload_by_type_check
messages_payload_by_type_check.value: ("messages"."type" = 'user' and "messages"."event_type" is null and "messages"."event_data" is null) or ("messages"."type" = 'system' and "messages"."event_type" is not null and char_length(btrim("messages"."event_type")) > 0)

sponsored_subscriptions_active_check.name: sponsored_subscriptions_active_check
sponsored_subscriptions_active_check.value: ("sponsored_subscriptions"."active" and "sponsored_subscriptions"."stopped_at" is null) or (not "sponsored_subscriptions"."active" and "sponsored_subscriptions"."stopped_at" is not null)

todo_access_requests_resolution_check.name: todo_access_requests_resolution_check
todo_access_requests_resolution_check.value: ("todo_access_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "todo_access_requests"."resolved_at" is null) or ("todo_access_requests"."status" <> 'pending' and "todo_access_requests"."resolved_at" is not null)

todo_blocks_payload_check.name: todo_blocks_payload_check
todo_blocks_payload_check.value: ("todo_blocks"."type" = 'text' and "todo_blocks"."text" is not null and "todo_blocks"."image_id" is null) or ("todo_blocks"."type" = 'image' and "todo_blocks"."text" is null and "todo_blocks"."image_id" is not null)

todo_workers_finished_state_check.name: todo_workers_finished_state_check
todo_workers_finished_state_check.value: ("todo_workers"."state" = 'doing' and "todo_workers"."finished_at" is null) or ("todo_workers"."state" = 'done' and "todo_workers"."finished_at" is not null)

users_hard_delete_schedule_check.name: users_hard_delete_schedule_check
users_hard_delete_schedule_check.value: ("users"."deleted_at" is null and "users"."hard_delete_after" is null) or ("users"."deleted_at" is not null and "users"."hard_delete_after" >= "users"."deleted_at")
